The '''Communications Advocate''' is the [[Players Committee]] advocate for communication with players: conveying news with Marketing, running the Player Surveys and moderating the forums.<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (Wayback copy of 10 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF])</ref> The current Communications Advocate is [[Keith Brown]].

To contact the Players Committee, see the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/contact/ Contact page] on starwarsccg.org.
